relations.evidence: Charles Hallisey is the Yehan Numata Senior Lecturer on Buddhist Literatures at Harvard Divinity School

relations.subject: Charles Hallisey
relations.evidence: Hallisey obtained his AB from Colgate University

relations.subject: Charles Hallisey
relations.evidence: and later a MA from the University of Pennsylvania.

relations.subject: Charles Hallisey
relations.evidence: Subsequently, he received his Ph.D. from the University of Chicago.

relations.subject: Charles Hallisey
relations.role: John L. Loeb Associate Professor of the Humanities in the Committee on the Study of Religion and the Department of Sanskrit and Indian Studies
relations.evidence: From 1996 to 2001 he was John L. Loeb Associate Professor of the Humanities in the Committee on the Study of Religion and the Department of Sanskrit and Indian Studies at Harvard University.

relations.subject: Charles Hallisey
relations.role: Associate Professor in the Department of Languages and Cultures of Asia and the Religious Studies Program
relations.evidence: Later in 2001 he joined the University of Wisconsin as Associate Professor in the Department of Languages and Cultures of Asia and the Religious Studies Program.

relations.subject: Charles Hallisey
relations.evidence: He joined the Faculty of Divinity of Harvard Divinity School in the academic year 2007–08.
